avis.texte: I've been using this product for over a month and have noticed some mild to moderate fading. I've been using it once a day (twice a day if I'm not wearing makeup) and only targeting patches of sun spots on my cheeks and hand. I have sensitive, acne prone skin and I can tolerate it as a spot treatment.

I have tried over twenty—or perhaps even thirty—products claiming to fade dark spots, yet those unsightly marks remain on my cheeks, the backs of my hands, and my arms. After spending six months hopefully using Eucerin Radiant Tone Dual Serum Dark Spot Corrector, I switched to this product. I've finished one bottle but haven't noticed any results yet; we'll see how it goes. I don't think the roller's massage function is necessary, as it causes too much product to dispense. The serum itself is rich and thick, so I only use it on my face at night.
